calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout | Development Sync
calls.summary: The meeting addressed critical strategies for enhancing marketing capabilities by allowing independent page creation through template duplication and block reuse, demonstrated by Lucas Elias. The team plans to facilitate effective editing controls, with a training session for safe workflows. Prioritization of important pages, like 'book a demo' and legal CMS designs led by Yousef, was established to enhance client engagement. Image production aimed at finalizing visual assets was 95% complete for key pages, with an emphasis on reusing images for consistency across platforms. Additionally, blog migration to Webflow is nearing completion, maintaining the same URL slugs for SEO benefits while ensuring accuracy through dedicated reviews by Karen. Communication plans were enhanced to ensure smooth transitions and project workflows.
calls.keywords: Webflow, Blog Migration, Page Templates, AI Content Generation, Legal CMS, Image Assets
